question: Is the strong RNA-only signal a biological signal or a preprocessing residue?

part1_numeric_semantics.interpretation: mixed: the shipped matrix is per-gene z-scored on the observed samples, with the imputed samples filled by a constant, so the whole-matrix moments are not unit

part2_imputation_structure.interpretation: Each gene was z-scored over its observed samples and the missing samples were filled with a single constant. The observed part of every imputed gene is an exact z-score, which proves the standardization happened before the imputation.

part3_centering_population.leakage_note: The shipped matrix is standardized over ALL of its columns, which includes validation-fold patients and 27 RNA samples that have no clinical row at all. The per-gene mean and standard deviation the model sees therefore carry information from patients outside the training fold. This is a transductive input leak, not a label leak: no outcome enters the matrix. Part 5 measures whether it changes the score.

part4_outcome_derived_probe.note: No gene is an exact algebraic function of the outcome, so the RNA matrix does not encode the label directly.

part5_signal_survival.estimator: multi-output ridge on the one-hot bin label, converted to a discrete survival matrix by cumulative hazard, scored with cancer_parity.parity_metrics
part5_signal_survival.archived_reproduction_note: The archived run did not record the exact survival-matrix conversion, so this audit does not claim to reproduce 0.7472266 bit-for-bit. Every variant here uses the identical estimator and metric code, so the differences between the variants are the quantity of interest.

boundaries.note: Read-only audit of an existing RNA matrix with a simple ridge probe. It does not retrain the survival network, does not touch the outer test partition and does not modify any patient artifact.
